notes.title: Meet TapTap Princess!
notes.content:
Hi folks! Long time no see, it's been a while since FTA's last game release. Now we want to proudly let you guys know about the next game in development, TapTap Princess, which happens in a fictional magic medieval world. Estimated release time would be middle July, more info will be updated, please stay tuned!

Hope to see you again soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43177980/9f84cba17be85d417780ca9f0d72b5aa84f49824.jpg[/img]
